ai_summary: Digitide Solutions Limited announced the immediate resignation of Mr. Saket Bhatnagar, their Chief Revenue & Growth Officer, effective September 21, 2026. This abrupt departure of a key senior management member responsible for revenue and growth could create strategic and operational disruptions for the company. While the stated reason is to pursue external opportunities, the immediate nature of the resignation from such a critical role warrants close monitoring for potential underlying business impacts.
